why_ai: Adversarial source operations and attribution need human analysts, though feeds and reports automate.
why_clarity: Value is unverifiable because success is an attack that never happened.
why_digital: Collected from online sources and delivered as feeds and portal reports.

why_ai: Context lookups and format plumbing are mechanical and largely solved.
why_clarity: Standard formats make each enrichment and delivery checkable instantly.
why_digital: Indicators enriched and routed entirely in software.

why_ai: Match rate and precision proxies are computable by software from telemetry.
why_clarity: Proxies are measurable, but the true outcome remains unobservable.
why_digital: Feeds and telemetry analysed in software.

why_ai: Careful adversary assessments need analyst judgment, though drafting and distribution automate.
why_clarity: No vendor learns whether any reader acted on a report.
why_digital: Sourced research published to an online portal.

why_ai: Delivery is solved and selection is modelling; underground collection access is the remaining edge.
why_clarity: Millions of near-identical indicators delivered in standard formats.
why_digital: Indicators streamed continuously into customer detection stacks.

why_ai: Indicator decay is observable and modellable by software.
why_clarity: Reallocation, sinkholing and expiry are checkable facts.

why_ai: It is a batch join between a feed and a log.
why_clarity: Whether an indicator ever fired is an exact computed count.
why_digital: Feeds joined to telemetry in a batch job.

why_ai: The join automates, though ground truth depends on analysts' investigation verdicts.
why_clarity: Malicious or benign is definable but verdicts are inconsistent and rarely joined back.
why_digital: SOC dispositions and indicator matches joined digitally.

why_ai: Customer exposure is largely observable and matchable by software.
why_clarity: Relevance is approximated and judged loosely by whether alerts matter.
why_digital: Customer asset and threat data matched online.

why_ai: Attribution and adversary forecasts are novel, adversarial judgments with no feedback.
why_clarity: Attribution assessments are almost never confirmed or refuted.
why_digital: Research and assessments produced on screen.

why_ai: Dismissing stale indicator alerts is repetitive triage that enrichment and suppression automate.
why_clarity: Alerts recur in volume, but dispositions are judged inconsistently.
why_digital: Alert queues worked entirely on screen.
